svg.title: Geometry bay — 4D tesseract, solid icosphere and torus knot in pure SVG SMIL
svg.desc: Three animated 3D renders with no JavaScript and no CSS: a tesseract rotating through the xw and zw planes and projected from four dimensions down to two, a solid icosahedron whose twenty faces are backface-culled and Lambert-shaded every frame, and a (2,3) torus knot drawn as depth-cued polyline bands with packets running the loop — a render test for the agent runtime by Ray Lin, agentic systems engineer, Taipei.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: geometry-bay --render 4d,solid,knot · pure-smil 3d — no js, no css

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', 'Liberation Mono', monospace

g.text: renderer: svg+smil · objects: 3 · faces: 20 culled/frame · edges: 42 · keyframes: 32/loop
